name: softland-moch
description: softland-moch — one command to install and control Moch, your AI agent at home, in your pocket. Mobile backend fork of hermes-agent (MIT, Nous Research). The command you type is `moch`.
author: Mamoun Hisham <mamounprogrammer@gmail.com>

scripts.postinstall: node bin/moch.js || (printf '\n[moch !] backend install did not finish — run \`moch\` to retry (nothing was lost).\n'; exit 0)
